description: A Lua module implementing a JSX-like string builder for HTML/XML generation, including utility functions for string manipulation, mapping, matching, and attribute formatting.

methods.name: utils.is_single_closing
methods.description: Checks if an element is a self-closing HTML tag based on a predefined list.

methods.name: utils.join
methods.description: Joins an array of strings with a specified separator.

methods.name: utils.map
methods.description: Maps data to strings using a callback function.

methods.name: utils.match
methods.description: Performs inline case matching based on a key and a set of cases.

methods.name: utils.split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array based on a separator.

methods.name: utils.filter
methods.description: Filters a numeric table based on a callback condition.

methods.name: utils.insert
methods.description: Inserts a string segment into a main string at a specified position.

methods.name: utils.format_props
methods.description: Formats a table of properties into an HTML attribute string.

methods.name: utils.children_to_string
methods.description: Converts children elements (string or table) into a concatenated string.

methods.name: luax
methods.description: Main function to generate HTML/XML strings with support for tags, properties, and children, mimicking JSX syntax.
